column1: # ETK — PER-TITLE PLAYABILITY STATUS (operator intel; the wiki mirrors this)
# THIS IS THE HUMAN LAYER THE LEDGER CANNOT SEE. Telemetry records that a
# session ran 7 minutes; it cannot tell whether those 7 minutes were a race or
# a main menu. Only the operator, at the rig, knows which. Without this file a
# stability chart makes an unplayable title look identical to a playable one —
# and worse, makes a title that never leaves its menus look STABLE, because a
# menu does not stress the GPU.
# It is also the filter that keeps the exit-hang analysis honest. Scanning the
# ledger for "all losses are R3, no GPU fault" produced seven candidates for
# "plays fine, hangs on quit" — but FALLOUT 3 is `menus` and Need for Speed:
# Most Wanted is `none`, so their R3s are a human giving up on a title that
# never started, not one refusing to close. Only two of the seven survive this
# The WIKI is the operator's working surface; this file is the machine-readable
# copy that tools/ reads. If they disagree, the wiki wins — re-sync this file.
#   playable    — completes/plays properly, the only status charts default to
#   in-game     — gets into gameplay but with significant problems
#   menus       — boots to menus, never reaches real gameplay
# Keyed on SERIAL. Titles are the wiki's own naming and may differ from the
# rig's launcher filenames (see the notes at the foot of this file).
